name: DeDoDe v2
plain: DeDoDe v2 (Chalmers, Linköping University; 3DV 2024): sparse keypoints from a detector network, descriptions from a separate one (VGG19, plus DINOv2 for -G), dual-softmax matches as keypoint index pairs (the form COLMAP takes). MIT; DINOv2 Apache-2.0.
summary: DeDoDe v2 (Edstedt et al., 3DV 2024; detector v2: CVPR Workshops 2024): detect, don't describe, describe, don't detect. A VGG19 network with convolutional refiners finds 10000 keypoints per image (the detector, retrained in v2), a separate descriptor network (VGG19, or VGG19 + a frozen DINOv2 ViT-L/14 for -G) describes them, and the descriptions are matched as mutual maxima of a dual softmax. Returns both keypoint sets, the index pairs of the matches and their probability.

papers.title: DeDoDe v2: Analyzing and Improving the DeDoDe Keypoint Detector

limitations: Sparse output: no dense warp. `result.matches()` gives the matched points for `estimate_pose`; `pairs` are the index pairs pycolmap / COLMAP databases take.
One image pair per call internally (batches run pair by pair); the match counts differ per pair.
No exportable module: the match counts are data-dependent (`torch.compile` runs with graph breaks; ONNX / TensorRT export fails).
Images are resized to a `size` x `size` square (default 784, as upstream) whatever their aspect ratio; the dual softmax holds a `max_keypoints`^2 matrix (10000 keypoints: 400 MB per float32 copy).
Upright only: the released descriptors are not trained for in-plane rotations.
task_io: Input: two RGB images of one scene. Output: for every pixel of the first image its position in the second (x, y in pixels) and a certainty that the pixel is visible in both. Sparse matchers (LightGlue) return the keypoints of both images and the index pairs of the matched ones instead.

variants.name: dedode-v2-b

training_data.name: MegaDepth (Internet photo collections with SfM / MVS depth)

licence.training_note: Detector v2 and descriptors: MegaDepth (README training section, papers); DINOv2 (-G, frozen): LVD-142M (Meta).

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream DeDoDe-L v2 + descriptor B, 10000 keypoints

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

quality.title: MegaDepth-1500, every 10th pair, relative pose AUC@5 / @10 / @20 degrees
quality.protocol: Dense matchers: 5000 matches per pair sampled from the warp by certainty (upstream's balanced KDE sampling); sparse matchers: all their matches of one call (LightGlue, XFeat: LightGlue's MegaDepth-1500 setting; LoFTR, DeDoDe: their card defaults). OpenCV essential-matrix RANSAC (0.5 px threshold, normalised by the mean focal length); AUC of the larger of the rotation and translation-direction errors.
